title: Check side platforms on bored stretches
detail: Not necessarily wrong, but noted (Ben, 28 October): 20 Metro stations have side platforms on a bored stretch, 19 deep (Lines 8, 10, 11, 12 in the 9.0 m bore; Pennsylvania Station on Line 1) and Taft Theater (shallow shield, Ben's setting). Listed on the hub page under Shared parameters, in the 3D issues, and on each station's card in the Deck. An island on the bore needs the tracks to spread from 3.9 to 10.9 m, which a deep station cannot do in a cut-and-cover box.
